{{Short description|Brazilian medical doctor and scientist (1927–2020)}}
'''Giovanni Gazzinelli''' (6 September 1927, in [[Araçuaí]] – 14 January 2020)<ref>[http://portal.sbpcnet.org.br/noticias/sbpc-lamenta-a-morte-de-giovanni-gazzinelli/ SBPC lamenta a morte de Giovanni Gazzinelli]</ref> was a Brazilian [[medical doctor]] and [[scientist]], with a [[PhD]] in [[biochemistry]] from the [[Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais]], with a specialization in [[immunology]].

Gazzinelli was Chief Scientific Investigator at [[Fiocruz]]. He received the ''grã-cruz'' ("Great Cross") of the ''[[Ordem Nacional do Mérito Científico|Ordem Naciona l do Mérito Científico]]'' ("[[National Order of Scientific Merit]]") of Brazil.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.abc.org.br/org/aca.asp?codigo=ggazzinelli |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências<!-- Bot generated title --> |access-date=2007-10-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927223119/http://www.abc.org.br/org/aca.asp?codigo=ggazzinelli |archive-date=2007-09-27 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
